alt: Apple HomeView smart home display, a compact rounded-square device with a 7-inch screen showing the Siri AI interface, sitting on a mesh speaker base, with an iPhone beside it displaying Siri AI conversation results
story: Apple's HomeView smart home display launches November 13, 2026 for $299, but pre-launch code analysis revealed it ships with HomeView OS 26.5 — software already six months out of date — while also lacking YouTube, Netflix, and most third-party apps at launch, and being entirely unavailable in the EU because its flagship Siri AI feature is blocked there by regulators.
why_funny: Apple spent years positioning its AI-first smart home hub as the definitive answer to Amazon Echo, then shipped it running half-year-old firmware, without the apps people actually watch, and unable to legally sell it in one of the world's biggest consumer markets.
